acceptance.given: A frozen valid-package Matrix Case, independently identified Stable and Candidate subjects, and its declared contract are available for evaluation.

oracle.expected: The case records separate attributable Stable and Candidate executions that handle the valid package under its declared contract; neither subject execution is omitted.
forbidden: The valid package is not handled under its declared contract.
oracle.observable: The valid-package case's two subject observations and their bound execution results.

acceptance.then: Both subject observations establish two-sided execution under the frozen declared contract.
acceptance.when: The Replay Matrix evaluates the valid-package Matrix Case.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the valid-package case with either the Stable or Candidate subject absent and observe aggregate rejection.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Record and validate separate Stable and Candidate execution observations for the valid-package case under its frozen declared contract.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing replay receipt and matrix compatibility; a missing subject remains unsuccessful.

slice_hint.state_transition: Frozen valid-package case without required two-sided observation -> separately observed Stable and Candidate executions under the declared contract.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The valid-package Matrix Case has separate Stable and Candidate observations, each bound to execution under the declared contract.

acceptance.given: A proposal requests TC-D1 work that includes Miner, Memory, Curator, autonomous Skill modification, SkillOS, learned ranking, percentage canaries, reinforcement learning, generalized governance, review-topology experiments, or cross-plan observability beyond TC-D1 evidence.

oracle.expected: The Toolchain scope decision rejects the proposal as outside TC-D1 and retains authorizes=[].
forbidden: Any listed excluded feature is accepted as TC-D1 scope.
Cross-plan observability beyond TC-D1 evidence is introduced as TC-D1 work.
A derived replay, seed, matrix, review, or Quick Dev artifact gains authorization.
oracle.observable: The deterministic scope-decision result produced while evaluating the proposed work boundary.

acceptance.then: The excluded proposal cannot enter the TC-D1 implementation scope.
acceptance.when: The Toolchain evaluates an excluded feature proposal against the TC-D1 scope boundary.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Present a proposal containing one explicitly excluded feature and require the scope check to reject it.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce the TC-D1 exclusion boundary so listed non-goals are rejected and derived evidence remains non-authorizing with authorizes=[].

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No excluded capability, authorization authority, or public Phase behavior is introduced.

slice_hint.state_transition: Excluded feature proposed as TC-D1 work -> proposal deterministically rejected outside TC-D1 scope.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Every listed excluded feature and cross-plan observability beyond TC-D1 evidence is rejected, while derived evidence exposes authorizes=[].

acceptance.given: Subjects, Probes, Matrix Cases, Consumers, and rollback stages participate in one Toolchain evaluation or rollback workflow.

oracle.expected: The isolation boundary check shows independently controlled mutable state and evidence for every listed component, with no cross-component contamination path.
forbidden: Any listed component shares mutable state with another listed component.
Cross-component mutable-state sharing permits one component to alter another component's execution or result.
oracle.observable: The isolation-boundary inspection and the cross-component substitution witness evaluated during matrix execution.

acceptance.then: Each component operates only on independently controlled mutable state and evidence.
acceptance.when: The Toolchain runs or rolls back the participating components and evaluates the isolation boundary.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Inject a cross-component mutable evidence substitution and require the isolation check to reject it.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Partition mutable state and evidence for Subjects, Probes, Matrix Cases, Consumers, and rollback stages, rejecting cross-component evidence substitution.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Existing replay results remain compatible; contamination is rejected rather than represented as success.

slice_hint.state_transition: Shared evaluation workflow with isolation required -> independently owned mutable state and evidence for all participating components.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The boundary check rejects a cross-component state or evidence substitution and finds no mutable-state sharing among the listed components.

acceptance.given: Consumer review is being prepared and the current repository call surface is available for reconciliation.

oracle.expected: Before review, a non-empty version-bound Consumer Manifest is reconciled bidirectionally with the repository real-call surface and frozen; it includes VDD package validation, Acceptance package validation, and workflow-model-routing observations.
forbidden: An empty Consumer Manifest is accepted.
The Consumer Manifest changes after review begins.
A repository caller is absent from the manifest or a manifest entry lacks a reconciled repository caller.
VDD, Acceptance, or workflow-model-routing observations are omitted.
oracle.observable: The version-bound Consumer Manifest, its bidirectional real-call-surface reconciliation, and its pre-review freeze boundary.

acceptance.then: Review proceeds only from the frozen, non-empty, reconciled Consumer Manifest.
acceptance.when: The Toolchain prepares and freezes the Consumer Manifest before Consumer review.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Evaluate an empty manifest and an attempted post-review manifest mutation; both must be rejected.
Omit a real VDD, Acceptance, or workflow-model-routing caller from either reconciliation direction and require rejection.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Build a non-empty version-bound Consumer Manifest from declared consumers and repository call-surface reconciliation, then freeze it before review.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Consumer Manifest version binding and existing consumer routes remain compatible; post-review mutation is rejected.

slice_hint.state_transition: Unfrozen Consumer review preparation -> non-empty, bidirectionally reconciled, version-bound manifest frozen before review.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The manifest is non-empty, includes VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing consumers, reconciles bidirectionally with repository callers, and rejects post-review mutation.
